name: lw_22697
statement: (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) : (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a)) ≥ (4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * a) + Real.sqrt (2 * b) + Real.sqrt (2 * c)) - 5 * Real.sqrt (a + b + c)) / 4
closed: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c), (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a)) ≥ (4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * a) + Real.sqrt (2 * b) + Real.sqrt (2 * c)) - 5 * Real.sqrt (a + b + c)) / 4
informal:
Let $ a,b,c$ positive real numbers. Prove or disprove that 

 $ \sum rac{a}{\sqrt{a+b}} \geq  rac{4(\sqrt{2a} + \sqrt{2b} + \sqrt{2c}) - 5\sqrt{a+b+c}}{4}$
